notes: All 12 snapshot files are Common Crawl captures; sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each file's footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp date. (1) Weatherhead/CWRU page is the 2012 Honor Roll of Donors 'Doctoral Alumni' section (donors who gave in calendar 2012), not a complete graduate list; names are grouped under year headings that the page never explains, each entry carries school codes and class years (GRS, MGT, CIT, NUR, SAS) and the page does not say which year/code is the doctoral degree, so yearMeaning is 'unstated' and the codes are copied into note. Susan H. Taft appears under both 1974 and 1988 (two rows). Entries written with 'Dr.' or 'Mr. and Mrs.' and no degree are kept as written with degree null; two 'and Mrs.' entries are couples, so the integrator should treat the named man as the alumnus only if confirmed elsewhere. Degree 'D.M.' (Doctor of Management) entries are included because the page is explicitly a doctoral page. (2) Columbia pages are the Business School Doctoral Program 'Dissertations' listing: each entry gives dissertation title, 'Name, Year' and Faculty Advisor; the year's meaning is not stated (likely dissertation/degree year), so yearMeaning is 'unstated'; program is recorded as 'Doctoral Program' because the page does not give the department. The index page (67d376) captures are of odd query-string variants of the listing that rendered the then-current year: 2015 entries (2 names) in the 2015-09-05 capture, 2016 entries (9 names) in the 2016-10-01 capture and 2017 entries (9 names) in the 2017-10-24 capture. Yena Stephanie Kim is listed as 2015 in the 2015 capture and 2016 in the 2016 capture. 'Pably Slutzky' (2017, blank advisor) is copied as written and is probably a typo. The 1998 page captures differ: the 2015-09-01 capture lists 10 names and the 2016-09-30 capture lists 10 names of which only 5 overlap (Gordon, Le Guyader, Manchanda, Millet-Reyes and Jin appear only in 2016; Xiao-Jun Zhang, Soares, Raskas, Naldi and Murmann appear only in 2015), so the page appears to show a window of entries and the full 1998 cohort is larger than either capture. Both 2001 captures show '1 of 2' with an 'Older items' link, so only the first page (10 of the 2001 entries) is captured; the two captures together give 11 distinct names. 1999 (9 names) and 2000 (7 names) captures show no pagination.
